checks.concern: Local payment eligibility failures dispatch no browser work
evidence: aoxiang_workflow_runner.py:214-231 runs the local preflight before current_configuration at 234-235 and before prepare_item/template/reserve.
Error updates retain original code/message/details through item_error; invalid items continue to the next stable identity.
checks.boundary: This is the four-code payment eligibility gate; final quantity/pricing/template and other prepare validation remains in its original later path.

checks.concern: Legacy/current operations preserve canonical health semantics
evidence: aoxiang_payment_preflight._view derives route through lifecycle.flow.stages and computes health with lifecycle.progress_state.
Absent modern return with existing legacy feedback falls back to lifecycle.snapshot for canonical SKU-completeness checking.
require_payment returns on existing canonical payment health; schema-1 historical dependency behavior is not tightened or bypassed.

checks.concern: Successful preflight does not authorize stale freeze or upload
evidence: freeze_payment still starts a fresh transaction, validates the head and calls canonical lifecycle.snapshot before require_payment.
validate_basis and the upload_item validate_for_upload dispatch gate remain unchanged.
Existing-package recovery skips the new preflight and preserves the original durable identity/recovery path.

checks.concern: Cancellation and deletion preserve stable writes
evidence: Preflight Cancelled returns the item to PENDING and rethrows.
The update closure retains item_id/oid/execution_token; Workflows.update validates the token and stable identity and rejects deleted sources.
SourceDeleted is handled without position-based fallback or any browser dispatch from the preflight branch.

checks.concern: Detailed payment errors preserve validation/audit gates
evidence: The four PaymentPreparationError codes distinguish missing, pending, changed dependencies and unready upstream without mutating lifecycle data.
Snapshot decode/integrity exceptions are not converted into a success or these specific payment classifications.
item_error persists exception details; message/UI changes retain the exact order/stage/version message and only specialize the dialog title.

limitations: Static source and relevant test-source review only; no new tests, EXE run, browser or platform operation was performed during this independent review.
No claim is made that every possible later freeze/template/pricing failure is covered by the lightweight payment eligibility preflight.
